mapper.select: SELECT id, material_name, type, description, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.material ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, material_name, type, description, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.material WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.material(material_name, type, description) VALUES(#{materialName}, #{type}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.material SET material_name=#{materialName}, type=#{type}, description=#{description}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.material SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dbo.material WHERE deleted = 0
